name: OpenVibe.Download
description: OpenVibe.Download is the file home of the OpenVibe network, in the spirit of MediaFire and MEGA: a 25 GB drive with folders and files up to 2 GB, share links that are public or for signed-in people, and folder backups from your computer with the openvibe-download command. Built on OpenVibe.Media and open through the API.

pillars.title: Your own drive
pillars.text: Folders and files up to 2 GB, 25 GB free, private to you, with previews of your pictures.

pillars.title: Share links
pillars.text: Public for anyone with the link, or for signed-in people or named accounts; expiring in an hour to 30 days, revocable, downloads counted.

pillars.title: Backups
pillars.text: Keep a folder on your computer backed up: make a sync key and run openvibe-download, which sends only what changed.

pillars.title: Reports that act
pillars.text: Every share page has a Report form, and reports suspend a share until staff look at it.

faq.question: How much can I store?
faq.answer: 25 GB, free, in folders private to you, with files up to 2 GB each and previews of your pictures.

faq.question: Who can open what I share?
faq.answer: You choose for each link: anyone with the link, signed-in OpenVibe people, or accounts you name. A link can expire in an hour up to 30 days, you can revoke it at any time, and its downloads are counted.

faq.question: Can it back up a folder from my computer?
faq.answer: Yes. Make a sync key on openvibe.download/sync and run the openvibe-download command: it sends only what changed since the last run.

faq.question: What happens when someone reports a share?
faq.answer: Every share page has a Report form, and a report suspends the share until staff look at it.

keywords: openvibe download, file sharing, file upload, cloud storage, backup, mediafire alternative
